name: sentfromai
description: Email for AI agents. Gives your agent its own inbox: create inboxes, send, reply in-thread, forward, search, manage drafts, domains, webhooks and allow/block rules. 21 annotated tools over SentFromAI's hosted MCP server, plus an email-etiquette skill.
